    Integer cocycles from an acyclic matching #

    For Proposition 7.6. An integer one-cocycle on a 2-complex (f_t + g_t = h_t on every triangle) is determined by arbitrary values on the unmatched edges of an acyclic matching: each matched edge is solved from its triangle, by recursion on the potential (zval, zval_tri). This is the abelian form of the collapse of Lemma 4.2 ("each matched edge is expressed through the remaining ones").

    zval_agree: on a set of edges closed under the matching triangles, a cocycle agreeing with the prescribed values on the unmatched edges of the set agrees with zval.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
